title: Sanguine Reach - Stats, Combo & How to Get
description: Sanguine Reach in Phantom Blade Zero - weapon class, slot, stats, combo contribution and how to obtain it, with unconfirmed numbers left marked as unconfirmed.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Sanguine Reach is a two-handed blade in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Two-handed root of the Tempering tree; it becomes Blazing Edge.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Sanguine Reach occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as Two-handed. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Sanguine Reach has no published damage, scaling or speed figure, because the game does not print a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons. Nothing has been measured for this one either, so those three numbers are absent rather than estimated - the slot and the property are what the choice actually turns on.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content:
The reason to carry it is its property rather than a damage number: Tempers into Blazing Edge.

Switching to it mid-combo refills stamina, so its practical job is to extend a chain past the point where the blade you were using runs dry. See the combat system for how the swap window works.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Weeping Creek Valley.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page records Sanguine Reach by slot, class and acquisition point, and by its property where one is published. Figures the game itself does not expose are left out. The system as a whole, with the full slot and class breakdown, is on the weapons list.
